questionText: In which year and under whose prime ministership was the Second Backward Classes Commission (Mandal Commission) appointed?

options.text: 1978 under the chairmanship of Bindeshwari Prasad Mandal (Morarji Desai Government)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Identifies 1978 under B.P. Mandal by Janata Party government.
Incorrect option '1953 under Kaka Kalelkar (Nehru Government)'. Confuses the exact sequence of historical treaties, elections, or political accords.

Incorrect option '1990 under V.P. Singh (National Front Government)'. Confuses powers or jurisdictions between different international or domestic organs (e.g. UN General Assembly vs Security Council, Planning Commission vs NITI Aayog).
Incorrect option '1975 under Indira Gandhi (Emergency Regime)'. Attributes a political stance, manifesto promise, or slogan to the wrong party or political faction.

detailedSolution:
The Second Backward Classes Commission, popularly known as the Mandal Commission, was appointed in December 1978 by the Morarji Desai Janata government under B.P. Mandal.
Hence, Option A is correct.

detailedSolution:

questionText:

detailedSolution:

Hence, Option A is correct.
